papers.title: Optimized Surface Characteristics and Enhanced in Vivo Osseointegration of Alkali-Treated Titanium with Nanonetwork Structures.
papers.abstract: Alkali-treated titanium (Ti) with a porous, homogeneous, and uniform nanonetwork structure (TNS) that enables establishment of a more rapid and firmer osteointegration than titanium has recently been reported. However, the mechanisms underlying the enhanced osteogenic activity on TNS remains to be elucidated. This study aimed to evaluate the surface physicochemical properties of Ti and TNS, and investigate osteoinduction and osteointegration in vivo. Surface characteristics were evaluated using scanning electron microscopy (SEM), scanning probe microscopy (SPM), and X-ray photoelectron spectrometry (XPS), and the surface electrostatic force of TNS was determined using solid zeta potential. This study also evaluated the adsorption of bovine serum albumin (BSA) and human plasma fibronectin (HFN) on Ti and TNS surfaces using quartz crystal microbalance (QCM) sensors, and apatite formation on Ti and TNS surfaces was examined using a simulated body fluid (SBF) test. Compared with Ti, the newly developed TNS enhanced BSA and HFN absorbance capacity and promoted apatite formation. Furthermore, TNS held less negative charge than Ti. Notably, sequential fluorescence labeling and microcomputed tomography assessment indicated that TNS screws implanted into rat femurs exhibited remarkably enhanced osteointegration compared with Ti screws. These results indicate that alkali-treated titanium implant with a nanonetwork structure has considerable potential for future clinical applications in dentistry and orthopedics.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究碱处理钛表面的纳米网状结构对骨整合的影响，但未涉及增材制造（AM）或多孔结构，且无机械测试。
llm.why_not_core: Does not involve LPBF fabrication, porous structure design for stress shielding, fatigue testing, or any mechanical characterization; focuses solely on chemical surface modification and in vivo osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索碱处理钛表面纳米网状结构促进骨整合的机制。
summary_zh.method: 制备钛纳米网状结构（TNS），通过SEM、SPM、XPS表征表面，用QCM测量蛋白质吸附，SBF测试磷灰石形成，体内植入大鼠股骨。
summary_zh.result: TNS增强了蛋白质吸附和磷灰石形成，体内实验显示骨整合显著增强。
summary_zh.validation: 通过表面表征、体外蛋白吸附和体内大鼠植入验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the mechanisms underlying enhanced osteogenic activity of alkali-treated titanium with a nanonetwork structure.
summary_en.method: Titanium nanonetwork structures (TNS) were characterized by SEM, SPM, XPS, solid zeta potential; protein adsorption via QCM; apatite formation in SBF; and in vivo implantation in rat femurs.
summary_en.result: TNS showed enhanced protein adsorption and apatite formation, and improved osseointegration in vivo compared to untreated titanium.
summary_en.validation: Validated through surface physicochemical characterization, in vitro protein adsorption and apatite formation tests, and in vivo animal experiments.
